BiblicalUsage: To grow pale is to blanch with shame, and God promises that Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale. The shame that whitened his face will be taken away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God removes the shame that makes His people pale, and the house of Jacob will not blush before its enemies again.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
